## Hypothesis

The VWAP continuation 2DTE override's edge is concentrated in Q4/Q1 and low VIX regimes; applying a regime filter (active only in Q4/Q1 and VIX<20) will improve out-of-sample consistency and walk-forward ratio without violating the min-3-lot floor constraint.

## Mechanism

Keep the existing `j_vwap_cont_dte_override=2` wiring (staging 2DTE onto the LIVE ATM Safe-2 cell). Add a pre-entry condition that checks:
- Quarter must be Q4 (Oct-Dec) or Q1 (Jan-Mar)
- VIX close (same day) must be < 20
If either condition fails, skip the VWAP continuation setup. All other logic (chart stop, profit-lock, exit) remains unchanged.

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (per leaderboard note on VWAPCONT_DTE_OVERRIDE_2DTE).
2. **Sample bias:** Base 2DTE override OOS sample spanned 2025-Q1 to 2026-Q2 (6 quarters). Regime filter reduces effective sample size; overfit risk if tuned to specific quarters/VIX levels without out-of-sample validation.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (filtered version not yet tested OOS).
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (filtered version not yet validated on real OPRA fills).
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: filter fails to exclude a high-VIX, low-quarter day causing large loss.
   - Max drawdown: could increase if filter whipsaws (frequent false entries/exits).
   - Blow-up: unexpected VIX spike >20 while filter is active, turning winning trades into losers.
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest to compute top-5 days % of P&L.
